pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area is largest on the mid-flank and significantly decreases in size toward the posterior and lower limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage forming interconnected pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections. Corridor pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder, characterized by a dark, textured boundary against the lighter background.
